post.summary: Sign in and get a bearer token
post.description: Accepts the same credentials as the web login: the owner password (owner mode), {"guest": true} (owner mode only), or username plus password (multi-user mode). Runs the same throttle as the web login, shared with it. An ungated server signs anyone in as the owner. Tokens are stateless: sign-out is the client forgetting its token; rotating SECRET_KEY signs out every phone and browser.

429.description: Too many wrong passwords from this address; wait a few minutes.

SessionRequest.description: Credentials. Send password (and username in multi-user mode), or guest: true.

can_write.description: Whether Sync is allowed. False for a guest.

token.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Store it in the Keychain.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working (7 days after sign-in, like the web session).
